title: te_abundance_v0 — long-format TE-abundance payload
description: Output envelope from extractors.te_abundance_table.extract. Long format: one row per (species × Repeat_Class × Repeat_Family). Sources the Chapter 5 Fig 5.1 stacked bar comparing 17 catfish genomes. The `rows` array preserves the original TSV row shape (column names from the header) — numeric columns are cast in place; unknown columns pass through unchanged so the page can render whatever the source provided.

species.description: Unique tree-tip labels found in the table, sorted.

classes.description: Unique Repeat_Class labels found in the table, sorted.

rows.description: One element per data row. Schema is open (additionalProperties: true) so the table can carry any columns the source TSV happened to provide; the recommended numeric columns are listed.
